title: Hottest Trends in Body sculpting This Year
paragraphs: Everybody wants to be in shape and has different goals for their bodies. Some individuals would be interested in tightening, building, and strengthening muscles in areas like the abdomen or butt. At the same time, some would want to remove excess fat from arms and thighs or even trim the skin and reshape body areas. This is not all; some would like to go for it all. For years, the common procedures among millennials remained liposuction, tummy tuck, and breast enhancements. These are often tied to a person’s weight loss or gain, common among millennials willing to take control of their health. They are looking for ways to reclaim their confidence in their body.

Liposuction (Lipo) – It reduces fat in targeted areas but has its fair share of side effects. If the fat increases, then the risk of complications increases. These changes can be permanent if you try to maintain a steady body weight, but it will not be the same if you start gaining weight.
Brazilian Butt Lift (BBL) – Fat from other body parts is grafted onto the buttocks under local anesthesia. The results are long-lasting as the patient’s fat is used in the procedure.

Emsculpt Neo – One of the hottest non-surgical body sculpting procedures everyone is talking about. It is an FDA-cleared non-invasive procedure for burning fat and building muscles while tightening the skin. It is a 30-minute session that transforms your body without any downtime. Emsculpt Neo uses high-intensity focused electromagnetic energy to make your muscles contract at a high-intensity rate. Did you know the contractions are like doing 24,000 crunches? Interesting isn’t it!

Coolsculpting – It is an FDA-cleared non-invasive body sculpting technique. Controlled cooling to freeze fat and eliminate what the person has been unable to remove from diet or exercise. The good thing is it is a permanent solution if the patient maintains a steady weight from when fat is eliminated from the body.

If you are tired of pockets of fat that don’t go away and are looking for solutions, we may be able to help you. You can learn more about Emsculpt Neo and how it is helping people get back in shape.
